name: Justified EvenRow Gallery for Elementor
author: Marcin

sections.description:
Justified EvenRow Gallery for Elementor adds a lightweight justified image gallery widget to WordPress sites built with Elementor.

The widget helps you create a clean, professional mosaic layout where image rows are visually balanced. It is especially useful when you want the gallery to avoid an awkward, unfinished-looking final row.

Features:

  • Justified mosaic image gallery for Elementor.
  • Balanced rows for a clean visual rhythm.
  • Optional even last row behavior.
  • Adjustable gutter and target row height.
  • Optional image cropping or containing.
  • Caption display on hover.
  • Compatible with Elementor Lightbox.
  • Lightweight frontend script with no unnecessary dependencies.

Elementor compatibility notice

Justified EvenRow Gallery for Elementor is an independent third-party plugin. It is not developed, sponsored, endorsed by, or affiliated with Elementor Ltd.

The name “Elementor” is used only to describe compatibility with the Elementor plugin. Elementor is a trademark of Elementor Ltd.

Disclaimer

This plugin is provided as is, without any warranty of any kind. Always test the plugin on a staging site before using it on a production website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the justified-evenrow-gallery-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor.
  5. Add the Justified EvenRow Gallery for Elementor widget and choose your images.
sections.faq:
Is this an official Elementor plugin?

No. Justified EvenRow Gallery for Elementor is an independent third-party plugin created by monolight. It is not affiliated with Elementor Ltd.

Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. The plugin adds a gallery widget to Elementor, so Elementor must be installed and active.

Does it work with Elementor Lightbox?

Yes. The gallery can use Elementor Lightbox when lightbox linking is enabled in the widget settings.

What is the main purpose of this plugin?

The main purpose is to create a clean justified mosaic gallery with balanced rows, including an option for a more even-looking last row.

short_description: A clean justified gallery widget for Elementor. Balances every row, including the last row, for a polished mosaic layout.
